crossCaseFindingUpdated: Fifth instance of the same family (case01/02/04/09, now 10): authored content exceeding its container, caught only by rendering and looking. This one is the simplest variant - a plain caption text wider than the scene - and confirms the finding is broader than 'arrows crossing labels': it is 'nothing checks that authored text fits its intended space,' whether that space is a box, a column header zone, or the scene's own width. See case09's critic-report.json for the fuller writeup; not repeating the recommendation here beyond noting the count.
